decisive_items: nail thickening over the pigmented band
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia
response.rationale: R2 is preferred due to the combination of clinical and histopathologic findings, including nail thickening and bland spindle cell proliferation, which are characteristic of onychomatricoma.

rejected.why: Lack of specific clinical findings and less comprehensive histopathologic description compared to R2.
